# 3D Nouns model assets

The GLB assets in this directory come from [0xFloyd/3DNouns](https://github.com/0xFloyd/3DNouns), a NounsDAO Proposal 2 project released under the MIT License.

- `body.glb`: shared animated body rig
- `HeadBonsai.glb`, `HeadBrain.glb`, `HeadApe.glb`: head variants

Nouns artwork is released under CC0. The model files are kept unmodified; Pinme Mesh applies scene lighting, animation selection, and status presentation at runtime.
